[[Dallas, Texas]] }} '''Darrell Antwonne Arthur''' (born [[March 25]], [[1988]] in [[Dallas, Texas]]), is an American basketball player who currently plays for the [[Kansas Jayhawks]]. Arthur is 6'9" tall, weighs 230 lbs, and plays [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] and [[small forward]]. His uniform number is 00, making him the first Jayhawk to wear that number since [[Greg Ostertag]]. Arthur is the first cousin of [[Los Angeles Clippers]] small forward [[Quinton Ross]]. In high school he guided [[South Oak Cliff High School]] to back-to-back Texas 4A state titles in 2005 and 2006 and was the tournament's MVP both years. In 2008, the Texas UIL stripped South Oak Cliff of the state title due to a WFAA Channel 8 investigation about Arthur's eligiblity. The coach bumped Arthur's math grade from a 45 to a 72 on the last day of grades to keep him eligible for the team. The Texas UIL awarded the 2005 title to Fort Worth Dunbar. Arthur declared for the 2008 NBA Draft, and during one of the pre-draft camp, he said that he had played his last game as a Kansas Jayhawk.
